prompt:
I refactored an old jQuery-based modal to use React and Cloudscape components. The modal now uses Button, Box, and SpaceBetween components from Cloudscape, and I added proper TypeScript types for all props. I also converted the inline styles to use Cloudscape tokens. Before I mark this as ready for code review, can you check if there are any remaining issues with the implementation?

Give your whole answer in your reply; do not create or change any files. Do not ask me questions; if something is unclear, make a reasonable assumption, list your assumptions in your final message, and finish the work.

rubric.criterion: The answer must recommend using React Hook Form for form state management if the modal contains form inputs.
The answer must recommend using Zod for validation if the modal contains form inputs.
The answer must recommend using imperative array building for 3 or more conditional items, not ternary chains.
The answer must not suggest using inline styles in the React implementation.
The answer must not suggest using the any type in production code.
